paragraphs: Manoach. (Manoach, father of Samson, Judges chapter 13, verse 2).

notes.text: פ״יג-ב gives Judges chapter 13 verse 2, and טו. gives Taanit 15a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The latter stop may also be terminal punctuation; earlier machine מ,, differs from supplied טו. Biblical Manoach father of Samson and Huna’s patronymic remain separate attestations. Huna’s Rav is full, without a heading-title transfer.
